graham.brief:
This game's number opened in one place and is sitting in another. The spread has moved 1.5 points toward Carolina. The direction has been consistent all week.

Cleveland's pass defense has been quietly good, 9th-best in the league against the pass. Two readings of the same game agreeing is a starting point, not a conclusion.

Carolina leans on play-action, and Cleveland has been hard to fool with it. According to Carolina Panthers, defensive signal-caller Devin Lloyd didn't practice on Wednesday. Deshaun Watson is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps, and Carolina carries the 10th-heaviest injury load in the league.

The price isn't arguing with any of that. Carolina is favored by 1.5 with a 42 total. Neutral on my side too, which is at least agreement. The books keep raising Judkins' carries even with his side as the underdog. The read stays flat until somebody scores first. That changes what both teams want.
